name: bl34-survivor-momentum-v1
notes: Returns are in percent: ret_6h_pct = 100 x (close of the last candle that ended at or before the decision / close of the last candle that ended at or before the decision - 6 h - 1); eth_ret_6h_pct and eth_ret_24h_pct the same on the ETH series (- 6 h, - 24 h). Either price missing = the field is missing = not in. No trade in the last 6 h gives 0, which fails > 0.
l24_depth = the +24 h label's best_qliq, else its qliq; it prices the impact on both sides (impact = 100 x side USD / l24_depth).
Friction per side = core/friction.py with launchpad 'other' (base 3%, no launchpad fee, impact) + fee_pct 1 on every trade; the Clanker pool fee is never added on top.
time_stop_min null = no time stop; liq_drop_pct null = no liquidity-pull exit (not in the spec); the trail runs after the first rung from the peak of earlier candles only.
Pass test 4: per trade, net P&L / 5 USD ticket vs ETH's return from the trade's entry fill to its exit fill (no friction), averaged over the trades.
Pass test 5: cumulative per-trade net P&L ordered by exit time on a 50 USD book; drawdown = (peak - equity) / peak.
Split: development = decision days up to 2026-11-07 UTC; holdout = decision days 2026-11-08 to 2026-11-14 UTC, run once.
